Offline vendored QRCode for JavaScript by Kazuhiko Arase, from the already-installed qrcode-terminal 0.12.0 vendor/QRCode directory. No download or registry request was made. Source files are unchanged; package.json scopes their existing CommonJS exports. Copyright/license notices are retained in each file and LICENSE (including upstream package attribution).

Used only by the Mac lab launcher. No package installation, browser dependency or network access is required. Verification: `node lab/test/session-qr.mjs` from the repository root. Tests check encoded byte payloads and rendered modules, not physical iPhone scanning. The launcher prints the exact URL, renders the terminal QR, saves a mode-0600 SVG under a private temporary directory and opens that local image on macOS when stdout is redirected or too narrow. Temporary QR files are removed on server close/normal exit. Forced termination such as SIGKILL cannot run cleanup; any remaining temporary SVG contains the expired session capability only.
